en.headline: Police arrest 38-year-old over Ferrari F40 near-miss with Citybus in Repulse Bay
en.dek: A local man was arrested on Monday on suspicion of dangerous driving after a classic Ferrari F40 pulled out from a side road into the path of a Citybus on Saturday evening.
body: Police arrested a 38-year-old local man on Monday on suspicion of dangerous driving after a red Ferrari F40 nearly collided with a Citybus on Repulse Bay Road on Saturday evening.

The incident occurred around 7pm near The Repulse Bay when the classic car, which carries a movement permit plate, emerged from a side road at a give-way junction without yielding, forcing the double-decker on route 973 to brake sharply. The vehicles avoided contact by a narrow margin.

Hong Kong Island Regional Traffic Investigation Unit reviewed video footage after receiving complaints and located the driver in Aberdeen. Officers said they would proceed with charges. Dangerous driving carries a maximum penalty of a HK$25,000 fine and three years’ imprisonment.
Citybus said the driver of the bus heading towards Stanley reacted promptly and no injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 淺水灣法拉利F40險撞城巴 38歲司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方周一在香港仔拘捕一名38歲本地男子，涉嫌與周六晚上淺水灣道一宗法拉利F40未讓路險撞城巴事件有關。
body: 警方港島總區交通調查組周一以涉嫌危險駕駛，拘捕一名38歲本地男司機。事件涉及一輛紅色法拉利F40經典跑車，於周六晚上約7時在淺水灣道近影灣園由小路駛出讓線路口時，險與一輛城巴相撞。
當時城巴973號線往赤柱方向的雙層巴士正沿大路行駛，車長見跑車突然駛出，即時急煞，兩車僅以極近距離避過碰撞。警方接獲兩宗投訴後主動調查並翻查片段，於香港仔鎖定涉案車輛。
警方表示將依法檢控，並呼籲司機駕駛時留意路況及遵守道路標記。危險駕駛最高可被判罰款2.5萬元及監禁3年。城巴表示事件未接獲受傷報告。
